prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right attorney depends on your case facts, severity of injuries, insurance/ liability issues, and who you feel comfortable working with. I can help you find a strong match. Below are practical tips and next steps.

What to look for
- Relevant experience: substantial experience handling car-accident and bodily-injury claims (not just general practice).  
- Trial experience: many cases settle, but trial experience matters if the insurer won’t offer fair compensation.  
- Track record: case results (settlements/verdicts) on similar cases.  
- Resources: firm must be able to pay expert fees, medical liens, investigative costs if needed.  
- Communication: clear process for who handles your file and how you’ll be updated.  
- Fee structure: contingency fee (common) and whether costs are advanced or deducted from recovery.  
- Credentials/reputation: AV Preeminent (Martindale-Hubbell), Super Lawyers, local trial lawyer associations, client reviews.

Where to search and verify
- Martindale-Hubbell, SuperLawyers, Avvo (Lawyers.com), Google/ Yelp reviews.  
- Illinois Trial Lawyers Association, Chicago Bar Association referrals.  
- Look up past verdicts/settlements in Cook County for evidence of results.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many car-accident injury cases like mine have you handled?  
- What were the typical outcomes? Any verdicts/settlements you can describe?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day? (partner vs. associate)  
- Do you take cases on contingency? What percentage and what costs will I owe if we don’t win?  
- Do you have the resources to hire experts (accident reconstruction, medical) if needed?  
- What’s your trial experience and how often do you go to trial versus settle?

Red flags
- Promises of specific settlement amounts before reviewing facts.  
- No trial experience and an unwillingness to take a case to court if needed.  
- Poor communication or evasive answers about who will handle the case.  
- Pressure to sign immediately without reviewing the fee agreement.

If you want, I can:
- Provide a short list of well-known Chicago personal-injury firms historically known for car-accident work (note: I can’t guarantee current standing unless you want me to look them up), or  
- Help you find and compare attorneys near your zip code — tell me where in Chicago you are and a few facts about the crash (injuries, who’s insured, police report, date), and I’ll suggest the next steps and questions tailored to your situation.

Which would you prefer?
